body:
The local `uiState` for each of the indices has to always be up to date, since we drive the `SearchParameters` (soon) from it. 

The reset page behaviour was implemented with a `setState` without change event. It means that each of the indices where we reset the page have a stalled `uiState` until the next internal change. To avoid this issue we use the regular `setState` function.
title: fix(index): use regular setState for reset
